title: Microsoft Edge / Chromium Browser Security Baseline Unenforced
description: Microsoft Edge Enterprise policies enforce SmartScreen download protection, password manager security, and disable obsolete WebRTC IP leakage.
impact: Users can bypass malicious site and malware download warnings in the primary web browser.
remediation_guidance: Apply Microsoft Edge Enterprise Security Baseline: Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' -Name 'SmartScreenEnabled' -Value 1
